description_en: Queries route entries that forward traffic to a network instance connection in the route table of a network instance associated with an Enterprise Edition transit router
description_zh: 调用ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttachment接口查询企业版转发路由器下网络实例路由表中指向网络实例连接的路由条目
name: ListCenChildInstanceRouteEntriesToAttachment

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时，每次显示的条目数。默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a next query token (Token) exists. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The route table ID of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

fields.help_en:
The route match mode.
prefix-exact-match: exact match
fields.help_zh:
路由匹配值模式。
prefix-exact-match：完全匹配
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The list of destination CIDR blocks
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The type of route hosting. If this field is empty, the route is not hosted. Valid values: TR, which indicates that the hosting type is transit router
parameters.help_zh: 路由托管的类型。如果该字段为空，即表示该路由没有被托管。取值：TR，表示托管类型为转发路由器类型
parameters.name: service_type

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether a next query token (Token) exists. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

RouteEntry.description_en: The details of the route entries

items.description_en: The details of the route entries

CenId.description_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID

ChildInstanceRouteTableId.description_en: The route table ID of the network instance

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

ServiceType.description_en: The type of route hosting. If this field is empty, the route is not hosted. Valid values: TR, which indicates that the hosting type is transit router
ServiceType.description_zh: 路由托管的类型。如果该字段为空，即表示该路由没有被托管。取值：TR，表示托管类型为转发路由器类型

Status.description_en:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:
Available: available.
Pending: being configured.
Modifying: being modified
Status.description_zh:
路由条目的状态。取值：
Available：可用。
Pending：配置中。
Modifying：修改中

TransitRouterAttachmentId.description_en: The ID of the network instance connection
